caption: Klein Matterhorn, Zermatt
composition: Klein Matterhorn ice terrace looking north to the Matterhorn’s south face · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Klein Matterhorn is the 3883-metre summit south of Zermatt, with an ice terrace looking north across the Theodul glacier to the south face of the Matterhorn about seven kilometres away. This is not the Gornergrat railway terrace of the Matterhorn scene, and the Hörnli ridge is not the skyline. Late September at this height is ice and old snow, and no cable-car name is readable. The Open-Meteo model is mainly clear with broken cloud, near freezing, and a strong north wind, with no precipitation.
